_note: Starting values estimated by hand from the source photo. Verify visually and tune. Coordinates are normalized 0-1 inside each crop unless stated.

source.note: Kept out of public/ so the 2048px original is never deployed.

desktop.depthChannels: R = depth (0 far, 1 near), G = subject mask

mobile.depthChannels: R = depth (0 far, 1 near), G = subject mask

depthMap.method: procedural: ground-plane gradient + person mask + face ellipsoid + nose bump + shoulders stepped back + hands forward
depthMap.status: second pass: chest step and right-leg seam smoothed with a 14px blur outside the head; face ellipsoid kept. Hand-correct hair edge near the right rail before launch.
depthMap.sourceFiles: assets/portrait/depth-desktop.png, assets/portrait/depth-mobile.png (first pass, kept for reference)

headParallax.note: applied to particle positions by depth (near particles move with the gaze, far ones against it)

tracking.backgroundParallax: comes from the depth map; do not add separate background motion

ctaGaze.note: gaze leans toward the hovered CTA or ad-solution item

blink.technique: eye particles sample the photo through a lid transform: skin from just above the eye is stretched down over it

devices.touch: nudge gaze toward touch point; otherwise idle motion only; no gyroscope
devices.reducedMotion: static images: public/portrait/starry-*.webp in the hero, particles-*.webp in Contact; no tracking, no idle motion
devices.noWebGL: same static images with identical layout and all content readable

privacy.note: Source file has no metadata. Keep it that way for any new export.

todo: Tune strength, easing, eye gain and particle counts by eye on real devices

particles._note: Starting values; tune on real devices. Counts are particles, not pixels.

heroAssembly.handoff: none: the painting is the hero. The particle portrait (with gaze and blinks) appears in Contact.
heroAssembly.density: face weight +1.6 and eye area +2.5 over the body, so gaze and blinks read in particles
heroAssembly.target: the hero painting after Van Gogh, The Starry Night (src/stage/starry.ts), which keeps moving as brushstrokes

sceneMorph.drivenBy: scroll progress of each scene timeline
targets: rails path (between scenes, How I work)

stage.textScrim: add when contrast is below WCAG AA

quality.adaptive: when frame time stays above 20 ms for 0.7 seconds: lower the pixel ratio to 1, then the count (down to 8000), then the pixel ratio to minDevicePixelRatio

particles.reducedMotion: no assembly, no trails, static portrait and panels

eyeRadiusPx._note: half-width and half-height of each eye opening in source pixels, measured on the 2048px source
